scope.summary: Ensemble is a macOS menu bar app, written in Swift, that drives Claude desktop sessions hands-free with a webcam; no data leaves the Mac.

not_applicable.pyproject, ruff, ty, uv, pytest, coverag: The repository has no Python. The equivalents are Package.swift, swift build -c release and swift test in ci.yml. Swift has no coverage gate here; the 142 tests run on every pull request.
not_applicable.pip-audit scheduled workflow: Swift Package Manager dependencies (Sparkle only) are covered by the dependabot.yml swift entry.

optins.DEVELOPER_ID_P12_BASE64: Developer ID Application certificate (.p12), used by release.yml to sign the app; a built-in token cannot sign.
optins.DEVELOPER_ID_P12_PASSWORD: Password of that .p12, used only to import it into a temporary keychain on the runner.
optins.NOTARY_KEY_P8: App Store Connect API key, used by release.yml so Apple notarizes the disk image; without it Gatekeeper rejects the download.
optins.NOTARY_KEY_ID: Key id of the App Store Connect API key.
optins.NOTARY_ISSUER_ID: Issuer id of the App Store Connect API key.
optins.SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY: Sparkle EdDSA key, used by release.yml to sign the update feed entry so installed copies accept updates.
optins.TRAFFIC_TOKEN: Fine-grained token for clonometer.yml: reads the repository's traffic (clones and views need Administration: read, which the built-in token cannot hold) and writes the daily count to the badges branch (Contents: write). The website shows the clone total from that branch.
